# Roblox Creator Docs: Studio & Scripting

All Roblox Creator Docs tips on this theme, grouped by topic, oldest first. Cross-creator synthesis: see [[README]] in roblox-kb.

## [[scripting-and-performance]]
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/production/configs) Call ConfigService only from server scripts; client calls error. Wrap GetConfigAsync in pcall with fallback values. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs production configs|Docs: production / configs]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/production/configs) Snapshots don't auto-update; connect UpdateAvailable to Refresh and use GetValueChangedSignal to apply changes safely, e.g., between rounds in a shooter. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs production configs|Docs: production / configs]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/curriculums/environmental-art/optimize-your-experience) Near the end of development, review all physics and rendering parameters and disable CastShadow on foliage away from gameplay areas to save performance. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials curriculums environmental-art optimize-your-experience|Docs: tutorials / curriculums / environmental-art ]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/education/adventure-game-series/selling-items) Always reset the items value to 0 after paying out; otherwise the touch script keeps granting gold on every touch. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs education adventure-game-series selling-items|Docs: education / adventure-game-series / selling-]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/education/adventure-game-series/selling-items) Guard each level of lookups with an if-check (player, leaderstats, items/gold) before reading or modifying values to avoid nil errors. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs education adventure-game-series selling-items|Docs: education / adventure-game-series / selling-]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/education/adventure-game-series/selling-items) Use GetPlayerFromCharacter() on partTouched.Parent to map a touched character part back to its Player before changing leaderstats. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs education adventure-game-series selling-items|Docs: education / adventure-game-series / selling-]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/education/lesson-plans/roblox-developer/roblox-developer-3) The leaderstats folder name must be exactly "leaderstats", otherwise the script won't create the leaderboard. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs education lesson-plans roblox-developer roblox-developer-3|Docs: education / lesson-plans / roblox-developer ]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/guides/data-stores/throttling) Exceeding requests/minute or throughput returns HTTP 429 Too Many Requests; batch or reduce writes and reads to stay under limits. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud guides data-stores throttling|Docs: cloud / guides / data-stores / throttling]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/guides/error-reporting) Use Group rules to merge errors that differ only in variable details like player names or IDs so counts aggregate under one label. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud guides error-reporting|Docs: cloud / guides / error-reporting]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/guides/error-reporting) Use Ignore rules to move known noisy errors into the Other bucket; totals are unchanged. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud guides error-reporting|Docs: cloud / guides / error-reporting]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/guides/error-reporting) Order rules carefully: the first matching rule wins, so put specific rules before broad ones. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud guides error-reporting|Docs: cloud / guides / error-reporting]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/guides/error-reporting) Rules only apply to new errors as they are processed; existing recorded errors are not changed. Allow a few minutes for changes to take effect. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud guides error-reporting|Docs: cloud / guides / error-reporting]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/guides/error-reporting) Avoid patterns starting with unanchored wildcards like .* or nested quantifiers like (\w+)+; these are rejected with 400. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud guides error-reporting|Docs: cloud / guides / error-reporting]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/guides/error-reporting) Ignore rule alternatives must start with at least 3 literal characters, e.g. ^AdService: is valid but ^\w+ is not. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud guides error-reporting|Docs: cloud / guides / error-reporting]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/guides/error-reporting) Review AutoGenerated rules suggested by Roblox (with matchedCount and sampleMessage) and dismiss unwanted ones via the ignore endpoint, which only works on AutoGenerated rules. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud guides error-reporting|Docs: cloud / guides / error-reporting]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials) Script hazard logic (lava, fading traps) and player data (score, health, persistent data) as separate gameplay systems. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials|Docs: tutorials]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/production/publishing/badges) Award badges only from server-side Scripts, and call GetBadgeInfoAsync first to confirm IsEnabled before AwardBadgeAsync, wrapping both in pcall. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs production publishing badges|Docs: production / publishing / badges]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/production/publishing/badges) Use UserHasBadgeAsync in PlayerAdded to check ownership, or GetUserBadgesAsync to check many badges in batches. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs production publishing badges|Docs: production / publishing / badges]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/education/adventure-game-series/collect-items) Use a BoolValue named CanHarvest inside the item as a state flag; check it with FindFirstChild before awarding anything. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs education adventure-game-series collect-items|Docs: education / adventure-game-series / collect-]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/education/adventure-game-series/collect-items) Set canHarvest.Value = false immediately on harvest so one tool swing cannot award more than one item. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs education adventure-game-series collect-items|Docs: education / adventure-game-series / collect-]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/education/battle-royale-series/creating-a-gui) Drive GUI text with .Changed connections on value objects instead of polling, and call the update function once at the end of the script so late joiners see current state. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs education battle-royale-series creating-a-gui|Docs: education / battle-royale-series / creating-]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/education/battle-royale-series/creating-a-gui) Use task.wait() with no argument in a timer loop for more accurate per-frame updates than a fixed wait. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs education battle-royale-series creating-a-gui|Docs: education / battle-royale-series / creating-]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/feature-packages/changelog) Base timers on Workspace:GetServerTimeNow() rather than DateTime.now() to keep client and server timers synchronized. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs resources feature-packages changelog|Docs: resources / feature-packages / changelog]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/feature-packages/changelog) Guard against infinite loops when initializing data for new players on the server (fixed in Missions Server.Missions). ([[2026-10-28 - Docs resources feature-packages changelog|Docs: resources / feature-packages / changelog]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/workspace/streaming) Wait for Workspace.PersistentLoaded before accessing persistent models in client scripts; otherwise use WaitForChild and tolerate streaming. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs workspace streaming|Docs: workspace / streaming]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/parts/solid-modeling) Wrap GeometryService calls in pcall, since operations fail on non-watertight meshes or meshes exceeding limits. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs parts solid-modeling|Docs: parts / solid-modeling]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/parts/solid-modeling) Use SplitApart = false when you want one result part rather than separate bodies; default is true, returning each body as its own part. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs parts solid-modeling|Docs: parts / solid-modeling]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/scene-analysis) Use Script Memory view to see Luau VM heap per Script, LocalScript and ModuleScript, separate from asset memory. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization scene-analysis|Docs: performance-optimization / scene-analysis]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/ui/proximity-prompts) Handle prompt events centrally with ProximityPromptService (PromptTriggered, PromptButtonHoldBegan, PromptButtonHoldEnded) instead of attaching a script to each prompt object. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials ui proximity-prompts|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / ui / proxim]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/ui/proximity-prompts) Keep event handlers thin: have the service script call functions in a ModuleScript (e.g. ObjectActions) so action logic stays in one reusable place. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials ui proximity-prompts|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / ui / proxim]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/lighting/create-flickering-lights) Read attributes once at script start and cache references to lights and beams rather than looking them up every frame. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials lighting create-flickering-lights|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / lighting / ]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/lighting/create-flickering-lights) Drive flicker from time() modulo a loop duration inside a Heartbeat connection so the cycle is deterministic and frame-rate independent. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials lighting create-flickering-lights|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / lighting / ]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/first-experience) Place scripts in the correct container service: Workspace renders, ReplicatedStorage is shared with clients, ServerScriptService is server-only. Wrong placement can break gameplay. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials first-experience|Docs: tutorials / first-experience]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/first-experience) Put shared gameplay logic that the UI needs in ReplicatedStorage, and put logic that launches or resets objects in ServerScriptService. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials first-experience|Docs: tutorials / first-experience]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/education/build-it-play-it-create-and-destroy/change-the-script) Keep tunable values such as point rewards in one settings table (GameSettings.pointValues) so balance changes need no logic edits. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs education build-it-play-it-create-and-destroy change-the-script|Docs: education / build-it-play-it-create-and-dest]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/education/build-it-play-it-create-and-destroy/change-the-script) Value type keys in pointValues must match folder names exactly, or points will not be awarded correctly. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs education build-it-play-it-create-and-destroy change-the-script|Docs: education / build-it-play-it-create-and-dest]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/the-mystery-of-duvall-drive/develop-a-moving-world) Use one LocalScript handling all CollectionService-tagged instances instead of many scripts to maintain. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs resources the-mystery-of-duvall-drive develop-a-moving-world|Docs: resources / the-mystery-of-duvall-drive / de]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/the-mystery-of-duvall-drive/develop-a-moving-world) Use point-in-box checks over pre-placed volumes rather than touch events, since seated players stop touching volumes. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs resources the-mystery-of-duvall-drive develop-a-moving-world|Docs: resources / the-mystery-of-duvall-drive / de]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/modules/selfie-mode) configure, setTheme, openSelfieMode, activateAction and similar functions can only be called from a LocalScript; place the module in ReplicatedStorage and configure it from StarterPlayerScripts. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs resources modules selfie-mode|Docs: resources / modules / selfie-mode]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/guides/alerts/metrics) Track HttpServiceResponseTime P90 and HttpServiceRequestsCount by status to find slow or failing external HTTP calls. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud guides alerts metrics|Docs: cloud / guides / alerts / metrics]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/fundamentals/coding-2/parameters-practice-buttons) Connect the function with button.Touched:Connect(buttonPressed) outside the function body, not inside it. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials fundamentals coding-2 parameters-practice-buttons|Docs: tutorials / fundamentals / coding-2 / parame]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/fundamentals/coding-2/parameters-practice-buttons) Use script.Parent to reference the button and workspace.<Name> with the exact Explorer name to avoid 'not a valid member of Workspace' errors. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials fundamentals coding-2 parameters-practice-buttons|Docs: tutorials / fundamentals / coding-2 / parame]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/characters/character-controller-library) Keep ability callbacks deterministic and non-yielding, since they run in both predicted client and authoritative server simulations. Never call task.wait or WaitForChild in callbacks. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs characters character-controller-library|Docs: characters / character-controller-library]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/characters/character-controller-library) Store custom callback data only in abilityCtx.State (replicated, rolled back) or abilityCtx.Local (scratch). Writing custom fields directly to abilityCtx is an error. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs characters character-controller-library|Docs: characters / character-controller-library]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/characters/character-controller-library) Within callbacks, avoid restricted DataModel operations such as Destroy; set an attribute and handle instance lifecycle from a regular script. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs characters character-controller-library|Docs: characters / character-controller-library]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/fundamentals/coding-6/coding-concept-algorithms) Use selection (if/then) for conditional outcomes, such as checking skill level before allowing item use. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials fundamentals coding-6 coding-concept-algorithms|Docs: tutorials / fundamentals / coding-6 / coding]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/fundamentals/coding-6/coding-concept-algorithms) Use iteration (loops with task.wait) for timed effects, such as lava dealing 5 health per second until respawn at 0. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials fundamentals coding-6 coding-concept-algorithms|Docs: tutorials / fundamentals / coding-6 / coding]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/ui/proximity-prompts) Use HoldDuration of 0 for instant actions; non-zero values require hold-event handling (PromptButtonHoldBegan/Ended). ([[2026-10-28 - Docs ui proximity-prompts|Docs: ui / proximity-prompts]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/education/battle-royale-series/managing-players) Use table.remove(arenaSpawns, 1) when assigning spawns so each player gets a unique spawn location. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs education battle-royale-series managing-players|Docs: education / battle-royale-series / managing-]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/education/battle-royale-series/managing-players) Use player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait() before accessing the character to avoid errors when the character hasn't loaded yet. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs education battle-royale-series managing-players|Docs: education / battle-royale-series / managing-]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/ui/interactive-ui) Put shared UI controller modules in ReplicatedStorage so both client and server-side scripts can require them. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials ui interactive-ui|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / ui / intera]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/ui/interactive-ui) Wrap UI callbacks in pcall so an error in one callback logs a warning instead of breaking the slider. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials ui interactive-ui|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / ui / intera]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/guides/inventory) Use the filter parameter with comma-separated assetIds to check ownership of several items in one request instead of one call per item. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud guides inventory|Docs: cloud / guides / inventory]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/guides/inventory) Combine filters with semicolons (e.g. onlyCollectibles=true;inventoryItemAssetTypes=HAT) to narrow results server-side. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud guides inventory|Docs: cloud / guides / inventory]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/guides/inventory) When paginating, check both a non-empty nextPageToken and a non-empty inventoryItems array; a divisible result count can yield an empty final page with a token. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud guides inventory|Docs: cloud / guides / inventory]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/projects/data-model) Place scripts in the correct containers: Script in ServerScriptService, LocalScript in StarterPlayerScripts/StarterGui, ModuleScript in ReplicatedStorage if shared. Wrong container means the script won't run or runs in the wrong place. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs projects data-model|Docs: projects / data-model]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/security/client-server-boundary) Rate limit server operations that hit DataStoreService or BadgeService, since exceeding their built-in limits makes requests fail. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs scripting security client-server-boundary|Docs: scripting / security / client-server-boundar]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/parts) Many partially transparent parts can slow performance; merge them using solid modeling to reduce the count. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs parts|Docs: parts]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/workspace/streaming/frustum) Set Player.FrustumStreaming only on the server; client-side assignments have no effect, so relay requests via RemoteEvent and validate them server-side. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs workspace streaming frustum|Docs: workspace / streaming / frustum]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/memory-stores/observability) Reduce request volume: DataStructureRequestsOverLimit and TotalRequestsOverLimit throttling triggers a critical alert above 10% of requests in an hour; count is what matters, not size. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services memory-stores observability|Docs: cloud-services / memory-stores / observabili]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/memory-stores/observability) Investigate request failures immediately: a critical alert fires when failures exceed 20% of requests within an hour. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services memory-stores observability|Docs: cloud-services / memory-stores / observabili]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/guides/usage-messaging) Disconnect MessagingService subscriptions when the player leaves (e.g. on AncestryChanged) to avoid leaking subscriptions. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud guides usage-messaging|Docs: cloud / guides / usage-messaging]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/guides/usage-messaging) Keep messages under 1,024 characters and topic names under 80 characters; larger payloads will be rejected. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud guides usage-messaging|Docs: cloud / guides / usage-messaging]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/guides/usage-messaging) Stay within rate limits: messages sent per server are 600 + 240 × players per minute; subscribe requests are capped at 240 per minute per server. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud guides usage-messaging|Docs: cloud / guides / usage-messaging]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/studio/mcp) Use script_grep and script_search to locate scripts; they return up to 50 and up to 10 results respectively. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs studio mcp|Docs: studio / mcp]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/education/battle-royale-series/coding-the-game-loop) Keep task.wait() inside repeat loops; without it the loop runs too many times per second and overloads Studio. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs education battle-royale-series coding-the-game-loop|Docs: education / battle-royale-series / coding-th]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/education/battle-royale-series/coding-the-game-loop) Set intermissionDuration above 1 second; shorter values make the wait loop repeat too often and cause slowdown. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs education battle-royale-series coding-the-game-loop|Docs: education / battle-royale-series / coding-th]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/education/battle-royale-series/coding-the-game-loop) Use a repeat...until loop for intermission so the lobby always runs at least once before checking player count. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs education battle-royale-series coding-the-game-loop|Docs: education / battle-royale-series / coding-th]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/education/battle-royale-series/coding-the-game-loop) Keep all game-loop code inside the while true do block; code placed after it never runs. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs education battle-royale-series coding-the-game-loop|Docs: education / battle-royale-series / coding-th]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/animation) Trigger sound and effects from marker signals rather than timing waits in code, so audio stays in sync with the animation. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs animation|Docs: animation]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/audio/objects) Avoid the legacy Sound, SoundGroup and SoundEffect objects; Roblox now discourages them in favor of AudioPlayer, AudioEmitter, Wire and audio effect objects. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs audio objects|Docs: audio / objects]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/audio/objects) Trigger audio from scripts by calling AudioPlayer:Play() on a correctly wired AudioPlayer, e.g. connected to a gameplay event. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs audio objects|Docs: audio / objects]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/workspace/cframes) Use CFrame.lookAt(pos, target) to orient a part's front surface toward a point; then apply a relative rotation to aim a different face. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs workspace cframes|Docs: workspace / cframes]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/chat/examples/proximity-chat) Use a dedicated channel instead of RBXGeneral in production so proximity rules don't affect the global chat. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs chat examples proximity-chat|Docs: chat / examples / proximity-chat]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/production/monetization/passes) Call RankProductsAsync once at game join rather than repeatedly, because it has a strict rate limit. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs production monetization passes|Docs: production / monetization / passes]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/production/monetization/passes) Wrap RecommendTopProductsAsync and RankProductsAsync calls in task.spawn with pcall so slow ranking calls don't block the game. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs production monetization passes|Docs: production / monetization / passes]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/input-and-camera/control-the-users-camera) Bind camera updates with RunService:BindToRenderStep at Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1 so your function runs after Roblox's default camera update. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials input-and-camera control-the-users-c|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / input-and-c]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/cross-server-messaging) Store the SubscribeAsync connection and call Disconnect when the player leaves to avoid leaking subscriptions. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services cross-server-messaging|Docs: cloud-services / cross-server-messaging]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/workspace/collisions) Set CanTouch to false on objects that don't need collision events to improve performance. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs workspace collisions|Docs: workspace / collisions]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/workspace/collisions) Don't call BindToCollisionSummaries from inside a Touched handler; it is a separate API. Disconnect the connection when no longer needed. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs workspace collisions|Docs: workspace / collisions]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/workspace/collisions) Debounce Touched handlers with an attribute cooldown, since Touched can fire repeatedly from settling or multi-part contacts. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs workspace collisions|Docs: workspace / collisions]])

- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/multithreading) Scripts run serially by default; put logic under Actors and call task.desynchronize() to get real parallel execution, since actors alone don't speed anything up. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/multithreading) Scripts in the same actor run sequentially; use multiple actors for logic units that should run on separate threads. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs scripting multithreading|Docs: scripting / multithreading]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/multithreading) Use more actors (e.g. 64+) split by logic unit rather than few large ones; finer granularity gives better load balancing across cores, but don't overdo it. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/art/modeling/surface-appearance) Author color maps in near-white grayscale so SurfaceAppearance.Color tinting gives the strongest effect; reuse one map with multiple tints to save memory. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/art/modeling/surface-appearance) For fresnel-related unexpected sheen on rough surfaces, increase the roughness map value by about 0.1. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs art modeling surface-appearance|Docs: art / modeling / surface-appearance]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/art/modeling/surface-appearance) Use partial metalness only for moderate-reflectance materials like satin or silk; otherwise use 0% or 100%. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs art modeling surface-appearance|Docs: art / modeling / surface-appearance]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/art/modeling/surface-appearance) Use an emissive mask instead of the all-or-nothing Neon material for detailed glow like illuminated text or bioluminescence. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/beyond-the-dark/layered-clothing) Keep each base body part under 10,000 triangles; body geo, cage parts and skeleton must follow the standard R15 schema. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/beyond-the-dark/layered-clothing) Always supply albedo, metalness, roughness and normal maps for SurfaceAppearance; missing metalness defaults to plastic and missing roughness to smooth. ## [[luau-language-and-types]]
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/luau/native-code-gen) Enable native code generation only on server scripts doing heavy numeric work on tables or buffers; top-level code runs once and gains little. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs luau native-code-gen|Docs: luau / native-code-gen]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/luau/native-code-gen) Prefer @native on specific hot functions instead of --!native everywhere; native compilation adds server startup time, memory use, and a total code limit. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs luau native-code-gen|Docs: luau / native-code-gen]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/luau/native-code-gen) Annotate function arguments with types, especially Vector3, so native code is specialized instead of checking for tables. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs luau native-code-gen|Docs: luau / native-code-gen]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/luau/native-code-gen) Avoid getfenv/setfenv, math functions called with non-numeric arguments, and mismatched argument types, since these deoptimize native code. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs luau native-code-gen|Docs: luau / native-code-gen]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/scheduler) Use task.wait, task.spawn, task.defer and task.delay instead of legacy wait, spawn and delay; the task versions are optimized and configurable and avoid throttling. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs scripting scheduler|Docs: scripting / scheduler]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/scheduler) Use task.spawn when a function may yield and you need it to run immediately; it resumes the thread right away through the engine scheduler. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs scripting scheduler|Docs: scripting / scheduler]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/scheduler) Use task.defer when you want the thread to run as soon as possible but not immediately; it runs after the current resume point in the frame. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs scripting scheduler|Docs: scripting / scheduler]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/scheduler) Use task.delay(0, f) as an alternative to defer; a zero duration resumes on the next Heartbeat step. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs scripting scheduler|Docs: scripting / scheduler]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/scheduler) task.wait() with no argument is equivalent to RunService.Heartbeat and yields one step; capture its return value to get the actual elapsed time. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs scripting scheduler|Docs: scripting / scheduler]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/luau/type-checking) Add --!strict as the first line of scripts to assert all inferred and annotated types and surface mismatches as warnings in Script Analysis. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs luau type-checking|Docs: luau / type-checking]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/luau/type-checking) Set a default type-check mode for all scripts via Workspace.LuauTypeCheckMode, then override per script as needed. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs luau type-checking|Docs: luau / type-checking]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/luau/type-checking) Annotate function parameters and return types so Luau warns on wrong argument types instead of erroring at runtime. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs luau type-checking|Docs: luau / type-checking]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/luau/type-checking) Use the ...type syntax (e.g. (...number) -> number) for variadic functional types; (...: number) only works in function definitions. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs luau type-checking|Docs: luau / type-checking]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/luau/type-checking) Put shared types in a ModuleScript and use export type, then require it and reference as Types.Name from other scripts. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs luau type-checking|Docs: luau / type-checking]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/luau/type-checking) Use :: casts sparingly; casting to any silences the checker, so prefer proper annotations. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs luau type-checking|Docs: luau / type-checking]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/fundamentals/coding-4/intro-to-for-loops) Use a for loop when code should run a fixed number of times; the loop takes control, end, and increment values separated by commas. Use a negative increment (e.g. -1) to count down from a higher start to a lower end. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/luau/comments) Use --!strict at the top of scripts to enable strict type checking. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs luau comments|Docs: luau / comments]])

- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/luau/metatables) __eq and __lt only fire when both operands share the same metamethod function and basic type; mixed table/userdata comparisons don't use them. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs luau metatables|Docs: luau / metatables]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/luau/metatables) Arithmetic metamethods receive operands in either order; check types of both args, since scalar division is not commutative. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs luau metatables|Docs: luau / metatables]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/luau/metatables) Set __mode to 'k', 'v', or 'kv' for weak tables; omitted modes stay strong. Don't rely on when GC removes entries. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs luau metatables|Docs: luau / metatables]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/modules/social-interactions) Trigger words use Luau string patterns (e.g. he+y+o* matches hey, heyyy, heyo) and are case-insensitive. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/luau/functions) Use colon notation (:) to call methods so self is passed automatically; table:Method() is identical to table.Method(table). ([[2026-10-28 - Docs luau functions|Docs: luau / functions]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/luau/functions) Remember Luau ignores extra arguments and passes nil for missing ones; missing args cause errors like arithmetic on nil. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs luau functions|Docs: luau / functions]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/luau/functions) Do not place code between a return statement and its end keyword; Luau throws an error. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs luau functions|Docs: luau / functions]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/luau/functions) Variadic token ... cannot be used inside nested functions defined within a variadic function; pack it into a table first. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs luau functions|Docs: luau / functions]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/luau/functions) Use table.pack-style packing like {...} to store variadic args, and unpack() to pass table values as arguments. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs luau functions|Docs: luau / functions]])

- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/curriculums/coding) Learn variables first: use them to ask players questions and reuse their answers in later text. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials curriculums coding|Docs: tutorials / curriculums / coding]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/events) Use signal:Once() instead of manually connecting then disconnecting when a function should only run the first time an event fires. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs scripting events|Docs: scripting / events]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/events) Use anonymous functions in Connect() when you need parent-scope variables and the handler isn't reused elsewhere. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs scripting events|Docs: scripting / events]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/luau/control-structures) In Luau, 0 and the empty string are truthy; only false and nil are falsy. Don't copy checks from other languages that treat 0 as false. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs luau control-structures|Docs: luau / control-structures]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/luau/control-structures) Use ipairs() for arrays and pairs() for dictionaries; pairs() traversal order is arbitrary. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs luau control-structures|Docs: luau / control-structures]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/luau/control-structures) Iterate tables directly with 'for i, v in t do' (generalized iteration) instead of ipairs() when appropriate. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs luau control-structures|Docs: luau / control-structures]])

- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/events/remote) Use UnreliableRemoteEvent for continuously changing, non-critical data; payloads over 1,000 bytes may be dropped. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs scripting events remote|Docs: scripting / events / remote]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/events/remote) Include a timestamp or sequence number in unreliable/out-of-order-sensitive messages and ignore messages older than the latest handled. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs scripting events remote|Docs: scripting / events / remote]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/events/remote) If order matters across remote types, send related messages through the same remote type or add your own sequence number. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs scripting events remote|Docs: scripting / events / remote]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/events/remote) Connect handlers before firing; RemoteEvent queues messages with no handler (limited queue), but UnreliableRemoteEvent discards them immediately. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/events/remote) Do not pass functions, metatable-based objects (metatables are lost), or ServerStorage/client-created instances in remote arguments; they arrive as nil. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/events/remote) Do not mix numeric and string keys in one table sent via remotes; non-string indices are converted to strings. Avoid nil values in tables. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs scripting events remote|Docs: scripting / events / remote]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/events/remote) Tables sent through remotes are copied, so compare contents rather than table identity. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs scripting events remote|Docs: scripting / events / remote]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/events/remote) Be aware that a yielding handler does not block the next message from starting; ordering applies to handler start, not completion. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs scripting events remote|Docs: scripting / events / remote]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/events/remote) Remote traffic from clients is throttled per remote type across all instances; excess RemoteEvent messages are delayed, excess Unreliable ones are dropped. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/modules/spawn-with-friends) Call configure and setTeleportationValidator only from a server Script, since the docs restrict both to Script context. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/players/avatar-editor) PromptSaveAvatar and PromptCreateOutfit do not yield; listen to PromptSaveAvatarCompleted / PromptCreateOutfitCompleted for the result. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs players avatar-editor|Docs: players / avatar-editor]])

## [[anti-exploit-and-security]]
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/guides/error-reporting) Send all three fields (pattern, output, regexOperation) on rule updates; an omitted output is cleared. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud guides error-reporting|Docs: cloud / guides / error-reporting]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/auth/oauth2-registration) Request only the minimum permission scopes your app needs; Roblox does not approve scopes for planned or future functionality. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud auth oauth2-registration|Docs: cloud / auth / oauth2-registration]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/auth/oauth2-registration) If you select the profile scope, you must also select openid. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud auth oauth2-registration|Docs: cloud / auth / oauth2-registration]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/security/third-party-vulnerabilities) Inspect all scripts in Toolbox models before use; watch for obfuscated code and whitespace hiding code off-screen in Studio. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs scripting security third-party-vulnerabilities|Docs: scripting / security / third-party-vulnerabi]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/security/third-party-vulnerabilities) Sandbox third-party models: set SandboxedInstance to Experimental on Workspace, then set the model's Sandboxed property to true. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs scripting security third-party-vulnerabilities|Docs: scripting / security / third-party-vulnerabi]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/security/third-party-vulnerabilities) Grant only the Capabilities an asset needs via its Capabilities property, rather than broad access. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs scripting security third-party-vulnerabilities|Docs: scripting / security / third-party-vulnerabi]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/security/third-party-vulnerabilities) Be especially cautious granting Network, DataStore, AssetRequire, CapabilityControl, or LoadString capabilities to third-party assets; backdoors commonly exploit these. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs scripting security third-party-vulnerabilities|Docs: scripting / security / third-party-vulnerabi]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/security/third-party-vulnerabilities) Prefer highly-rated community assets vetted by other developers, but popularity does not guarantee safety. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs scripting security third-party-vulnerabilities|Docs: scripting / security / third-party-vulnerabi]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/security/third-party-vulnerabilities) Expect some features to error with 'lacking Capability Unassigned' while sandboxed during beta; grant the needed capability. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs scripting security third-party-vulnerabilities|Docs: scripting / security / third-party-vulnerabi]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/education/resources/intro-to-digital-safety) Enable 2-Step Verification on your Roblox account so a password alone cannot log in; a unique code is emailed at each login. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs education resources intro-to-digital-safety|Docs: education / resources / intro-to-digital-saf]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/education/resources/intro-to-digital-safety) Treat free Robux offers and requests for account info as scams; Roblox staff never ask for passwords or personal identifying information. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs education resources intro-to-digital-safety|Docs: education / resources / intro-to-digital-saf]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/education/resources/intro-to-digital-safety) Do not follow links outside Roblox, even from friends; lookalike domains (rublux.com, r0blox.com) and texture-upload tutorials have been used to steal accounts. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs education resources intro-to-digital-safety|Docs: education / resources / intro-to-digital-saf]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/education/resources/intro-to-digital-safety) Apply the Rule of 3: verify a claim against three trusted sources before believing it. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs education resources intro-to-digital-safety|Docs: education / resources / intro-to-digital-saf]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/education/support/roblox-account-creation) Never share your Roblox password, even with real-life friends. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs education support roblox-account-creation|Docs: education / support / roblox-account-creatio]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/education/support/roblox-account-creation) Make passwords hard to guess; do not just append digits to your username (e.g. bloxcool123). ([[2026-10-28 - Docs education support roblox-account-creation|Docs: education / support / roblox-account-creatio]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/education/support/roblox-account-creation) Roblox employees never ask for passwords; report anyone who does using Report Abuse. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs education support roblox-account-creation|Docs: education / support / roblox-account-creatio]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/reference/errors) Gateway errors with code 0 (e.g. 'Invalid API Key') mean auth/routing failed before the endpoint ran; check the key and its scopes first. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud reference errors|Docs: cloud / reference / errors]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/chat/examples/rate-limit-public-text-inputs) Enforce cooldowns on the server, storing last-action timestamps per UserId; never trust client-side timers for rate limits. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs chat examples rate-limit-public-text-inputs|Docs: chat / examples / rate-limit-public-text-inp]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/security/security-tactics) Assume every client-sent value is manipulated. Validate all critical actions server-side, since client-side checks will eventually be bypassed by exploiters. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs scripting security security-tactics|Docs: scripting / security / security-tactics]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/security/security-tactics) Server should validate price, player money, and distance before approving a purchase, then subtract currency on the server itself. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs scripting security security-tactics|Docs: scripting / security / security-tactics]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/security/security-tactics) Keep logic and data in ServerScriptService from day one. Never put them in ReplicatedStorage or Workspace where exploiters can decompile them. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs scripting security security-tactics|Docs: scripting / security / security-tactics]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/security/security-tactics) Threat-model every feature: how it could be exploited, worst-case value, behavior at 1,000+ calls/sec, maximum sensible rate, and worst-case resource use. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/security/security-tactics) Expose the minimum internal state needed by a feature to the client. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs scripting security security-tactics|Docs: scripting / security / security-tactics]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/security/security-tactics) Device Trust API is optional. Act on the trust level yourself (separate places, limit trading, or reject), and still validate server-side because trusted devices can exploit weak validation. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs scripting security security-tactics|Docs: scripting / security / security-tactics]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud) Consider Roblox webhooks for event notifications such as refunds or subscription changes instead of polling the API. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud|Docs: cloud]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/projects/data-model) Put server-only logic in ServerScriptService, which is never replicated to clients, to keep it secure. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs projects data-model|Docs: projects / data-model]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/security/client-server-boundary) Check context on the server: distance to shop, key ownership, character alive, and other permissions before granting rewards or changing shared state. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/security/client-server-boundary) Verify instance arguments by checking IsDescendantOf the expected folder and class, since exploiters can send fake tables mimicking Instances. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/security/client-server-boundary) Use math.isfinite() to reject inf and NaN; NaN fails all comparisons, so range and balance checks silently pass. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs scripting security client-server-boundary|Docs: scripting / security / client-server-boundar]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/security/client-server-boundary) Never rely solely on client-side rate limits; enforce rate limits on the server for every client-triggerable action. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs scripting security client-server-boundary|Docs: scripting / security / client-server-boundar]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/security/client-server-boundary) Use a token bucket limiter: TokenBucket.new(5, 10) allows bursts of 5 and refills one token every 2 seconds. Clear per-player buckets on PlayerRemoving. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs scripting security client-server-boundary|Docs: scripting / security / client-server-boundar]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/security/client-server-boundary) Treat ProximityPrompt, ClickDetector and DragDetector events as remotes: exploiters can fire them from any distance and ignore Enabled or MaxActivationDistance. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/security/client-server-boundary) Only ProximityPrompt.Triggered has a server-side distance check; re-check distance, state and cooldowns yourself for the other events. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/security/client-server-boundary) For critical actions, anchor parts or use the network ownership API, since unanchored parents let exploiters take ownership and bypass distance checks. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/players) Use BanAsync with ApplyDeviceBlock true to block the user's desktop device for 24 hours; this does not apply to mobile or console. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs players|Docs: players]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/players) Note that device blocks do not propagate to other accounts on the device, and calling the unban API immediately lifts the device block. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs players|Docs: players]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/curriculums/studio/create-account) Roblox employees never ask for your password; report anyone who does using Report Abuse. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/curriculums/studio/create-account) Ignore anyone or any site claiming free Robux; treat such offers as scams. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials curriculums studio create-account|Docs: tutorials / curriculums / studio / create-ac]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/education/educator-onboarding/2-playing-on-roblox) Add an email to your Roblox account for extra security and to avoid lockout if the password is forgotten. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs education educator-onboarding 2-playing-on-roblox|Docs: education / educator-onboarding / 2-playing-]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/guides/usage-messaging) Create API keys with only messaging-service and universe-messaging-service:publish permissions to limit blast radius. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud guides usage-messaging|Docs: cloud / guides / usage-messaging]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/modules/profile-card) Players' custom status text is subject to text filtering; expect free-text fields to be filtered and plan for it. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs resources modules profile-card|Docs: resources / modules / profile-card]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/auth/oauth2-reference) Identify users by the userinfo sub (Roblox user ID), not name or display name, since users can change both. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud auth oauth2-reference|Docs: cloud / auth / oauth2-reference]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/auth/oauth2-reference) Exchange authorization codes server-side with client_secret; codes expire after 1 minute and work only once. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud auth oauth2-reference|Docs: cloud / auth / oauth2-reference]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/auth/oauth2-reference) Don't rely on introspect to detect revoked authorization; it reports revoked access tokens as valid until their lifetime ends. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud auth oauth2-reference|Docs: cloud / auth / oauth2-reference]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/auth/oauth2-reference) Use token/resources for stateful checks of which resources a user granted; use introspect only for stateless validation of token claims. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/transparent-batching) Wrap network-bound API calls in pcall() so one failed request does not abort the whole operation. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs scripting transparent-batching|Docs: scripting / transparent-batching]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/projects/groups) Keep Place Copying disabled before adding private assets to a group game, and confirm each member's role to protect intellectual property. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs projects groups|Docs: projects / groups]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/network-ownership) Validate all physics-driven data from clients, since clients owning a part can teleport it, pass through walls or fly it. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics network-ownership|Docs: physics / network-ownership]])

- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/data-stores/error-codes-and-limits) Check serialized value size with HttpService:JSONEncode() before saving; each key is capped at 4,194,304 characters. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services data-stores error-codes-and-limits|Docs: cloud-services / data-stores / error-codes-a]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/data-stores/error-codes-and-limits) Keep data store names, key names and scopes under 50 characters each; check with string.len(). ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services data-stores error-codes-and-limits|Docs: cloud-services / data-stores / error-codes-a]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/data-stores/error-codes-and-limits) Plan storage: limit is 500 MB + 1 MB per lifetime user (anyone who has joined once); only latest key versions count toward usage. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services data-stores error-codes-and-limits|Docs: cloud-services / data-stores / error-codes-a]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/data-stores/error-codes-and-limits) Handle throttle codes 301-306 (queue full, request dropped) and KeyThrottled/DatastoreThrottled by backing off and retrying. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services data-stores error-codes-and-limits|Docs: cloud-services / data-stores / error-codes-a]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/data-stores/error-codes-and-limits) Limit metadata: 50-char key names, 250-char values, 300 characters total for key-value pairs. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services data-stores error-codes-and-limits|Docs: cloud-services / data-stores / error-codes-a]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/parts/procedural-models) If a place is saved while a model is dirty, regeneration is queued and runs on next load; failed generation clears dirty state until the next parameter change. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs parts procedural-models|Docs: parts / procedural-models]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/multithreading) Use SharedTable for large shared state across actors; updates are atomic and visible to all actors, and cloning uses structural sharing rather than copying. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs scripting multithreading|Docs: scripting / multithreading]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/ui/text-filtering) Filter text loaded from DataStores (e.g. pet names) before displaying, since stored text may contain inappropriate words. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs ui text-filtering|Docs: ui / text-filtering]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/data-stores/best-practices) Create fewer data stores and organize records by key, e.g. one PlayerData store rather than one data store per player. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services data-stores best-practices|Docs: cloud-services / data-stores / best-practice]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/data-stores/best-practices) Store each player's persistent data under one key (e.g. User_123456) when it fits the 4 MB object size limit. Reduces requests and allows atomic updates. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services data-stores best-practices|Docs: cloud-services / data-stores / best-practice]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/data-stores/best-practices) Split a player's record into a small number of deterministic keys only when parts have different access patterns or hit per-key size/throughput limits. Keep atomically-changed data together. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services data-stores best-practices|Docs: cloud-services / data-stores / best-practice]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/data-stores/best-practices) Build keys from stable identifiers like User_{UserId}. Never use display names or changeable values, so keys stay predictable and RTBF can find them. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services data-stores best-practices|Docs: cloud-services / data-stores / best-practice]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/data-stores/best-practices) Use key prefixes (e.g. User_123456/Profile/Warrior) to group related keys and list them with ListKeysAsync. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services data-stores best-practices|Docs: cloud-services / data-stores / best-practice]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/data-stores/best-practices) Don't use DataStore2 for new experiences. If you use it, migrate with Roblox's official beta DataStore2 migration tool. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services data-stores best-practices|Docs: cloud-services / data-stores / best-practice]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/data-stores/best-practices) Load player data at session start, keep a server-local copy, and save periodically, on leave, on server shutdown, and at critical checkpoints like purchases. Periodic save interval example: 180 seconds. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services data-stores best-practices|Docs: cloud-services / data-stores / best-practice]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/data-stores/best-practices) Keep the periodic save interval within request limits and shorter than any session-lock expiration. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services data-stores best-practices|Docs: cloud-services / data-stores / best-practice]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/data-stores/best-practices) Wrap data store calls in pcall and retry transient failures with capped exponential backoff plus random jitter. Don't retry invalid-request errors. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services data-stores best-practices|Docs: cloud-services / data-stores / best-practice]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/data-stores/best-practices) Process retries in order per key; an older retry landing after a newer successful write can overwrite newer data. Account for writes with unknown outcomes after a failed call. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services data-stores best-practices|Docs: cloud-services / data-stores / best-practice]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/data-stores/best-practices) Prefer UpdateAsync over SetAsync when writes depend on the current value or multiple servers may write the same key. Use SetAsync only for new keys or values independent of prior state. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services data-stores best-practices|Docs: cloud-services / data-stores / best-practice]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/data-stores/best-practices) When polling shared sharded keys, add a random initial delay and bounded jitter between reads; avoid all servers reading immediately after a shared event. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services data-stores best-practices|Docs: cloud-services / data-stores / best-practice]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/data-stores/best-practices) Don't shard data that needs atomic updates across all readers or that is already below its per-key read throughput limit. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services data-stores best-practices|Docs: cloud-services / data-stores / best-practice]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/data-stores/best-practices) Use data store versions instead of new keys per revision. Only the latest version counts toward storage, and versions allow inspection or restore. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services data-stores best-practices|Docs: cloud-services / data-stores / best-practice]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/data-stores/best-practices) Use MemoryStore for temporary, rapidly changing data; it expires automatically and doesn't add to persistent storage. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services data-stores best-practices|Docs: cloud-services / data-stores / best-practice]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/data-stores/best-practices) Delete test data and data for expired events or retired features. Marked data stores can be restored within a 30-day buffer before permanent deletion. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services data-stores best-practices|Docs: cloud-services / data-stores / best-practice]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/luau/queues) MemoryStoreService queues are non-persistent; use them for transient work, not for saving player data. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs luau queues|Docs: luau / queues]])

- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/modules/spawn-with-friends) Set teleportToFriendOnRespawn to false if friend teleports should happen only on demand via teleportToRandomFriend instead of on every respawn.
