- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/modules/spawn-with-friends) Spawn-with-friends works better in games with large open spaces, since the module checks there is enough room before spawning to avoid placing characters inside geometry. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs resources modules spawn-with-friends|Docs: resources / modules / spawn-with-friends]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/modules/spawn-with-friends) Enable showLogs while debugging to see module log messages in the Output window; it is off by default. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs resources modules spawn-with-friends|Docs: resources / modules / spawn-with-friends]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/battle-royale/core-scripts) Split a battle royale across places by role: Lobby for mode selection, Queue for gathering players, Gameplay for the match, so each server only runs what it needs. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs resources battle-royale core-scripts|Docs: resources / battle-royale / core-scripts]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/battle-royale/core-scripts) In queue places, start a countdown once the minimum player count is reached rather than starting immediately; the template uses a 3:00 countdown. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs resources battle-royale core-scripts|Docs: resources / battle-royale / core-scripts]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/the-mystery-of-duvall-drive/main-design-requirements) Group players (five per group) in a simple lobby, then teleport them once into a reserved server so late joiners cannot miss story beats. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs resources the-mystery-of-duvall-drive main-design-requirements|Docs: resources / the-mystery-of-duvall-drive / ma]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/the-mystery-of-duvall-drive/main-design-requirements) Use a scripted cutscene system (EventManager-style) to hide streaming and teleports behind camera shakes, effects and audio. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs resources the-mystery-of-duvall-drive main-design-requirements|Docs: resources / the-mystery-of-duvall-drive / ma]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/luau/queues) Use priority queues for matchmaking and raise the priority of players who have waited longer so they are served first. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs luau queues|Docs: luau / queues]])

## [[physics-pathfinding-and-npc-ai]]
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials) Use constraints (hinges, ropes, welds) for mechanical connections like door hinges. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials|Docs: tutorials]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/universal) Make both attachments' SecondaryAxis perpendicular to each other; the green L indicator confirms correct orientation. Misoriented axes make the universal move incorrectly. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints universal|Docs: physics / constraints / universal]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/universal) Enable LimitsEnabled to restrict tilt to a cone using MaxAngle; set Restitution to control elasticity when the limit is reached. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints universal|Docs: physics / constraints / universal]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/ball-socket) Enable LimitsEnabled to expose UpperAngle for tilt limiting within a cone; enable TwistLimitsEnabled to restrict twist via TwistLowerAngle and TwistUpperAngle. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints ball-socket|Docs: physics / constraints / ball-socket]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/ball-socket) With LimitsEnabled on, point each attachment's Axis in the same direction so rotation occurs around the intended axis. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints ball-socket|Docs: physics / constraints / ball-socket]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/ball-socket) Restitution (exposed when LimitsEnabled is on) sets how elastic the attachments are when they hit tilt or twist limits. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints ball-socket|Docs: physics / constraints / ball-socket]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/torque) Torque applies constant torque and angular acceleration; without other forces speeds can get very high. Use AngularVelocity for steady rotation speed. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints torque|Docs: physics / constraints / torque]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/torque) To set only an initial spin, set BasePart.AssemblyAngularVelocity directly on the assembly instead of using a constraint. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints torque|Docs: physics / constraints / torque]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/torque) Torque defaults to being relative to Attachment0, so it changes direction as the parent assembly rotates. Set RelativeTo to World for fixed world-axis torque. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints torque|Docs: physics / constraints / torque]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/security/security-tactics) Clients can take network ownership of their character and unanchored parts, so don't rely on client-reported physics or position for gameplay decisions. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs scripting security security-tactics|Docs: scripting / security / security-tactics]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/animation) Use inverse kinematics APIs to procedurally drive motion from events, e.g. head tracking a flying bird or an arm reaching for a door knob. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs animation|Docs: animation]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/network-ownership) Set vehicle ownership to the driver via server-side SetNetworkOwner on VehicleSeat Occupant changes, and reset with SetNetworkOwnershipAuto when vacated, so driver input is not delayed by passengers. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics network-ownership|Docs: physics / network-ownership]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/network-ownership) Assign ownership of loose parts sitting on a vehicle to the same client that drives it, for smooth behaviour. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics network-ownership|Docs: physics / network-ownership]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/network-ownership) Use SetNetworkOwner(nil) for gameplay-critical server-controlled parts sparingly; overuse can cause jittery physics for clients. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics network-ownership|Docs: physics / network-ownership]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/physics/create-spinning-objects) Larger parts have higher moment of inertia and need more torque for the same acceleration; scale MaxTorque with part size. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials physics create-spinning-objects|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / physics / c]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/physics/create-spinning-objects) For a part spinning on a stationary base, use a HingeConstraint with ActuatorType Motor and anchor the base so only the spinning part moves. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials physics create-spinning-objects|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / physics / c]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/physics/create-spinning-objects) Use ApplyAngularImpulse for an instant spin that decelerates from friction; good for gusts of wind or event feedback. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials physics create-spinning-objects|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / physics / c]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/physics/create-spinning-objects) Enable Show Constraint Details in the View menu to visualize constraint axes and rotation direction while configuring. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials physics create-spinning-objects|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / physics / c]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/physics/create-spinning-objects) Orient attachment primary axes (yellow arrow) upward on Y to spin counterclockwise; reverse the sign to spin clockwise. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials physics create-spinning-objects|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / physics / c]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/mover-constraints) Replace deprecated BodyPosition with AlignPosition; set ForceLimitMode to PerAxis to get independent per-axis force limits like BodyPosition. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics mover-constraints|Docs: physics / mover-constraints]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/mover-constraints) Replace deprecated BodyGyro with AlignOrientation; use AlignType PrimaryAxisLookAt for cameras or guided missiles that track a target. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics mover-constraints|Docs: physics / mover-constraints]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/mover-constraints) Replace deprecated BodyVelocity with LinearVelocity; use Line, Plane, or Vector VelocityConstraintMode to disable motion along chosen dimensions instead of zeroing MaxForce. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics mover-constraints|Docs: physics / mover-constraints]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/mover-constraints) Replace BodyForce or BodyThrust with VectorForce; use RelativeTo to apply force at an offset from center, like BodyThrust.Location. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics mover-constraints|Docs: physics / mover-constraints]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/mover-constraints) Replace RocketPropulsion with LineForce for follow-target behaviour plus AlignOrientation with LookAtPosition for face-target behaviour. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics mover-constraints|Docs: physics / mover-constraints]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/mover-constraints) Use AngularVelocity with Attachments and RelativeTo (World or Attachment1) to control the frame of applied torque; note it has behavioural discrepancies vs BodyAngularVelocity. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics mover-constraints|Docs: physics / mover-constraints]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/mover-constraints) Switch Studio from Geometric to Physical mode to test realistic constraint behaviour, e.g. ropes becoming taut when dragging a part. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics mover-constraints|Docs: physics / mover-constraints]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/cylindrical) For vehicle suspensions, pair CylindricalConstraint (wheel slides up/down and spins) with a SpringConstraint for shock absorption. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints cylindrical|Docs: physics / constraints / cylindrical]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/cylindrical) Align each attachment's Axis and SecondaryAxis to point the same direction so rotation occurs around the intended axis. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints cylindrical|Docs: physics / constraints / cylindrical]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/cylindrical) Use ActuatorType/AngularActuatorType Motor to drive toward a Velocity/AngularVelocity; control with MotorMaxForce/MotorMaxTorque and acceleration limits. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints cylindrical|Docs: physics / constraints / cylindrical]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/cylindrical) Use Servo actuator mode to move to a TargetPosition or TargetAngle; tune Speed/AngularSpeed, responsiveness, and ServoMaxForce/ServoMaxTorque. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints cylindrical|Docs: physics / constraints / cylindrical]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/cylindrical) Enable LimitsEnabled and AngularLimitsEnabled to bound sliding and rotation; Restitution sets bounce at limits. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints cylindrical|Docs: physics / constraints / cylindrical]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/cylindrical) Use InclinationAngle (-180 to 180, from X axis in Attachment0's X/Y plane) to tilt the rotation axis without changing the sliding axis. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints cylindrical|Docs: physics / constraints / cylindrical]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/angular-velocity) Use AngularVelocity only when you need a constant spin; it applies torque to maintain the target velocity. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints angular-velocity|Docs: physics / constraints / angular-velocity]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/angular-velocity) Use a Torque constraint instead if you need to control the amount of torque applied. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints angular-velocity|Docs: physics / constraints / angular-velocity]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/angular-velocity) For only an initial spin, set BasePart.AssemblyAngularVelocity on the assembly directly rather than adding a constraint. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints angular-velocity|Docs: physics / constraints / angular-velocity]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/angular-velocity) Set RelativeTo to World to use the angular velocity vector as-is; use Attachment1 to make it relative to the other attachment's motion. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints angular-velocity|Docs: physics / constraints / angular-velocity]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/angular-velocity) ReactionTorqueEnabled is only exposed when RelativeTo is set to Attachment1. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints angular-velocity|Docs: physics / constraints / angular-velocity]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics) For complex mechanisms like tanks, set a fixed timestep to improve stability instead of relying on adaptive timestepping. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics|Docs: physics]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics) Use collision groups or part-to-part filtering to control which assemblies collide with each other. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics|Docs: physics]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/rigid) Use RigidConstraint (not WeldConstraint) when connecting Attachments or Bones, e.g. attaching accessories to attachments on a character rig. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints rigid|Docs: physics / constraints / rigid]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/physics/build-a-ferris-wheel) Set a HingeConstraint's ActuatorType to Motor so it turns on its own; by default it only turns when an outside force acts on it. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials physics build-a-ferris-wheel|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / physics / b]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/physics/build-a-ferris-wheel) AngularVelocity is in radians per second; use multiples of pi (e.g. pi/10 = 0.314 for a slow turn) for precise rotation speeds. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials physics build-a-ferris-wheel|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / physics / b]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/physics/build-a-ferris-wheel) Set MotorMaxTorque to inf (copied from MotorMaxAcceleration) so the mechanism can handle any load, such as player-filled cars. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials physics build-a-ferris-wheel|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / physics / b]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/physics/build-a-ferris-wheel) Only one motor is needed per rotating assembly; avoid adding motors on both sides of the wheel. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials physics build-a-ferris-wheel|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / physics / b]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/physics/build-a-ferris-wheel) Use as few constraints as possible in contraptions; this keeps them stable and reliable. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials physics build-a-ferris-wheel|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / physics / b]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/torsion-spring) Set Damping above 0 to stop endless oscillation; Damping = 0 oscillates forever, higher values settle the spring faster. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints torsion-spring|Docs: physics / constraints / torsion-spring]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/torsion-spring) Enable LimitsEnabled and set MaxAngle to restrict the spring's range within a cone; use Restitution to control elasticity at the limit. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints torsion-spring|Docs: physics / constraints / torsion-spring]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/improve) Keep adaptive physics stepping (60/120/240 Hz); fixed 240 Hz mode forces four steps per frame and costs significantly more. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization improve|Docs: performance-optimization / improve]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/improve) Minimize constraints and joints per assembly, and disable self-collision in ragdoll limbs with limits or no-collision constraints. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization improve|Docs: performance-optimization / improve]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/rope) Use WinchSpeed as a positive value only; a negative value reverts to 0 rather than reversing the winch direction. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints rope|Docs: physics / constraints / rope]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/rope) To reel a rope in or out, enable WinchEnabled and set WinchTarget to the desired rope length in studs. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints rope|Docs: physics / constraints / rope]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/rope) RopeConstraint only limits maximum separation; attachments may move closer and rotate freely, so use it for slack-tolerant ropes. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints rope|Docs: physics / constraints / rope]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/rope) Tune Restitution to control bounce at the rope's length limit; it sets elasticity when the separation limit is reached. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints rope|Docs: physics / constraints / rope]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/sleep-system) If a slow-moving assembly falls asleep unexpectedly, it's usually moving below the sleep thresholds; wake it via impulses or constraint property changes. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics sleep-system|Docs: physics / sleep-system]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/sleep-system) Use actuated joints (Motor/Servo hinges, AlignPosition with RigidityEnabled=false, etc.) for slow controlled motion; they use a stricter sleep threshold so they don't fall asleep prematurely. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics sleep-system|Docs: physics / sleep-system]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/sleep-system) Changing BasePart physics properties (Anchored, CanCollide, velocities, Massless, etc.), applying impulses, or changing Workspace Gravity/wind wakes the whole assembly. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics sleep-system|Docs: physics / sleep-system]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/sleep-system) Larger assemblies rotate at lower angular velocity before falling asleep, because rotational velocity scales with the bounding sphere radius. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics sleep-system|Docs: physics / sleep-system]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/ui/3D-drag-detectors) For physical drag, tune MaxForce (default 10000000), MaxTorque (default 10000) and Responsiveness (default 10) instead of relying on defaults. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs ui 3D-drag-detectors|Docs: ui / 3D-drag-detectors]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/no-collision) Use NoCollisionConstraint to disable collision between two specific parts, e.g. a vehicle wheel and its body, instead of a broad collision group. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints no-collision|Docs: physics / constraints / no-collision]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/no-collision) NoCollisionConstraint only affects the two parts it connects; they still collide with all other world parts. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints no-collision|Docs: physics / constraints / no-collision]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/animation) Use IsKinematic=true when connected parts must snap precisely to the transform without participating in physics simulation. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints animation|Docs: physics / constraints / animation]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/animation) Set IsKinematic=false when parts should follow the target trajectory via force and torque rather than snapping. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints animation|Docs: physics / constraints / animation]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/animation) For non-kinematic constraints, tune MaxForce and MaxTorque to limit how strongly parts are driven toward the transform. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints animation|Docs: physics / constraints / animation]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/hinge) Point both attachments' Axis (yellow arrow) in the same direction, or the hinge will rotate around the wrong axis. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints hinge|Docs: physics / constraints / hinge]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/hinge) Use ActuatorType Motor to drive toward AngularVelocity, limited by MotorMaxAcceleration and MotorMaxTorque. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints hinge|Docs: physics / constraints / hinge]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/hinge) Use ActuatorType Servo to rotate to TargetAngle, controlled by AngularSpeed and ServoMaxTorque. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints hinge|Docs: physics / constraints / hinge]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/hinge) Enable LimitsEnabled and set LowerAngle/UpperAngle to restrict swing, e.g. for doors; tune Restitution for bounce at limits. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints hinge|Docs: physics / constraints / hinge]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/prismatic) Use ActuatorType Motor to drive toward a Velocity, limited by MotorMaxAcceleration and MotorMaxForce. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints prismatic|Docs: physics / constraints / prismatic]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/prismatic) Use ActuatorType Servo to move to a TargetPosition, tuned with Speed, LinearResponsiveness and ServoMaxForce. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints prismatic|Docs: physics / constraints / prismatic]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/prismatic) Enable LimitsEnabled and set LowerLimit/UpperLimit to restrict sliding range; Restitution sets elasticity at limits. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints prismatic|Docs: physics / constraints / prismatic]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/the-mystery-of-duvall-drive/supporting-systems) Use a 2D horizontal-distance check to pick the nearest respawn point when there is no checkpoint system. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs resources the-mystery-of-duvall-drive supporting-systems|Docs: resources / the-mystery-of-duvall-drive / su]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/workspace/streaming/techniques) Move distance checks and line-of-sight/position-sensitive logic to the server, since clients see stale property values for streamed-out instances. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs workspace streaming techniques|Docs: workspace / streaming / techniques]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/projects/client-server) Assemblies are simulated by one owner (client or server) and other clients receive position updates; ownership is usually automatic but can be set manually for responsiveness. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs projects client-server|Docs: projects / client-server]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/use-case-tutorial-overview) Understand assemblies and network ownership before building moving objects, since they determine how physics behaves in real time. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials use-case-tutorial-overview|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / use-case-tu]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/plane) Set Attachment0's orientation to define the plane: its primary axis is the plane normal. Attachment1's orientation has no effect on the plane. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints plane|Docs: physics / constraints / plane]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/plane) Remember both parent assemblies stay free to translate and rotate unless other constraints limit them; PlaneConstraint alone does not pin either part. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints plane|Docs: physics / constraints / plane]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/characters/pathfinding) Use Humanoid:Move() waypoint-to-waypoint with a Heartbeat check for arrival rather than moving the character directly. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs characters pathfinding|Docs: characters / pathfinding]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/characters/pathfinding) Connect Path.Blocked and recompute, but only when the blocked waypoint index is ahead of the current waypoint; ignore blocks behind the agent. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs characters pathfinding|Docs: characters / pathfinding]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/characters/pathfinding) Wait until the humanoid is grounded before calling ComputeAsync; paths computed mid-fall start from an inferred position. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs characters pathfinding|Docs: characters / pathfinding]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/characters/pathfinding) Set costs to a high finite value (100 or 1000) instead of math.huge for materials to use only as a last resort; math.huge makes them non-traversable. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs characters pathfinding|Docs: characters / pathfinding]])

- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/characters/pathfinding) For custom traversal (e.g. boats), use a PathfindingLink with a label and give its Costs entry a lower value than Water so the agent prefers it. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs characters pathfinding|Docs: characters / pathfinding]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/physics/create-elevators) Use PrismaticConstraint with Limits Enabled and ActuatorType Servo to drive a platform along one axis with fixed orientation. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/physics/create-elevators) Set Restitution to 0 on prismatic limits so the platform does not bounce when reaching the upper or lower limit. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/physics/create-elevators) Set ServoMaxForce high enough (example 10000) so the platform holds its weight against gravity while moving. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/microprofiler/task-scheduler) Set physics-affecting gameplay logic (e.g. BasePart.Velocity) in RunService.PreSimulation, which runs before physics. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/microprofiler/task-scheduler) Read physics state (e.g. BasePart.Position for zone entry detection) in RunService.PostSimulation, which runs after physics. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/assemblies) Set RootPriority on a part to influence which part becomes the assembly root; higher values take precedence. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics assemblies|Docs: physics / assemblies]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/projects/server-authority/techniques) Smooth mispredicted objects by rendering a massless, non-colliding, anchored visual clone that tracks an invisible simulated part with TweenService:SmoothDamp (smoothTime about 0.07). - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/units) Keep PhysicalProperties within limits: density 0.0001–100 RMU/stud³, friction 0–2, elasticity 0–1, friction/elasticity weight 0–100. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics units|Docs: physics / units]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/units) Default gravity is 196.2 studs/s² (≈54.936 m/s² metric), about 5.6× real-world 35 studs/s² (9.8 m/s²); tune constraint and mover forces with these units in mind. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics units|Docs: physics / units]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/physics/create-moving-objects) Set LinearVelocity MaxForce high enough to reach target speed; too low and the object accelerates slowly or never reaches it. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/physics/create-moving-objects) Use PrismaticConstraint to lock movement to one axis for stable, predictable motion, e.g. moving platforms players must time jumps on. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials physics create-moving-objects|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / physics / c]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/physics/create-moving-objects) Anchor one attachment's parent part with a PrismaticConstraint in Motor mode so only the unanchored assembly moves at the set velocity. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/physics/create-moving-objects) Balance impulse force per character: player characters have different masses, so a fixed impulse may launch light players too high. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/physics/create-moving-objects) Set RelativeTo to World, not Attachment, if the object should keep its world orientation; attachment-relative motion rotates after collisions. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/mechanical-constraints) Switch to Physical mode when dragging parts so they obey physical limits; e.g. a taut RopeConstraint will pull the other part along. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/mechanical-constraints) Most mechanical constraints need a secondary Attachment or Bone; WeldConstraint and NoCollisionConstraint instead link Part0/Part1 directly. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/mechanical-constraints) Use NoCollisionConstraint to stop two specific parts colliding while they still collide with the rest of the world. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics mechanical-constraints|Docs: physics / mechanical-constraints]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/linear-velocity) Use LinearVelocity when you need to maintain a constant velocity; use VectorForce when you need to control the amount of force applied. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/linear-velocity) For only an initial velocity, set BasePart.AssemblyLinearVelocity directly on the assembly instead of using a constraint. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints linear-velocity|Docs: physics / constraints / linear-velocity]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/linear-velocity) Set LinearVelocity.RelativeTo to World for world-space force, or to Attachment0/Attachment1 to follow that attachment's orientation. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints linear-velocity|Docs: physics / constraints / linear-velocity]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/spring) Set FreeLength to the spring's natural resting length; attachments farther apart are pulled together, closer ones pushed apart. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints spring|Docs: physics / constraints / spring]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/spring) Use Damping 0 only if you want endless oscillation; raise Damping to settle the spring to rest faster. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints spring|Docs: physics / constraints / spring]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/spring) Raise Stiffness for a stronger force response to displacement from FreeLength; the docs contrast 25 with 500 as soft versus stiff. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints spring|Docs: physics / constraints / spring]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/spring) Enable LimitsEnabled and set MinLength/MaxLength to clamp spring travel; attachments stop at these limits without restitution. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints spring|Docs: physics / constraints / spring]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/align-orientation) By default AlignOrientation only applies torque to Attachment0; enable ReactionTorqueEnabled to apply equal and opposite torque to Attachment1 too. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/align-orientation) Use AlignType PrimaryAxisParallel, PrimaryAxisPerpendicular or PrimaryAxisLookAt to apply torque only when primary axes misalign, instead of AllAxes. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/align-orientation) Set RigidityEnabled to true for the solver to align as fast as possible; when false, tune MaxTorque, MaxAngularVelocity and Responsiveness instead. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/align-orientation) Use OneAttachment mode to align Attachment0 to a CFrame goal or to PrimaryAxis/SecondaryAxis; TwoAttachment mode ignores those properties. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/services) Use RunService for per-frame updates and to check whether code runs on server, client, or in Studio mode. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs scripting services|Docs: scripting / services]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/attributes) Anchor physics objects (e.g. Anchored on a thrown javelin or discus) at the moment they land to give players a clear visual of the result. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs scripting attributes|Docs: scripting / attributes]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/vector-force) VectorForce applies constant force, so speed grows unbounded without opposing forces; use LinearVelocity for steady velocity instead. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/vector-force) To set only initial velocity, assign AssemblyLinearVelocity directly on the assembly rather than using VectorForce. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/vector-force) By default VectorForce applies at Attachment0; if center of mass is misaligned, torque results. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/vector-force) Use RelativeTo=Attachment0 for thruster-like forces that follow rotation, and RelativeTo=World for fixed directional forces like wind. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/align-position) By default AlignPosition only applies force to Attachment0; Attachment1 is unaffected unless ReactionForceEnabled is true. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/align-position) Enable ApplyAtCenterOfMass to avoid unwanted torque when the parent's center of mass is off the force direction. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints align-position|Docs: physics / constraints / align-position]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/align-position) Use RigidityEnabled=true for the fastest possible alignment; use MaxForce, MaxVelocity and Responsiveness when you need controlled, non-rigid movement. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics constraints align-position|Docs: physics / constraints / align-position]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/constraints/align-position) Set Mode to OneAttachment to move Attachment0 to the Position property; TwoAttachment (default) moves Attachment0 to Attachment1's position. ## [[combat-and-gameplay-systems]]
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/weapons-kit) Set BulletSpeed to about 20000 to simulate laser/raycast weapons; default 1000 gives projectile travel. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs resources weapons-kit|Docs: resources / weapons-kit]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/weapons-kit) Use StartupTime (default 0.2s) to stop players firing one shot from several weapons in quick succession. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs resources weapons-kit|Docs: resources / weapons-kit]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/weapons-kit) Set ShotCooldown for semi-auto/auto fire rate; default 0.1s, and it is also the time between automatic shots. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs resources weapons-kit|Docs: resources / weapons-kit]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/weapons-kit) Use NumProjectiles for multi-pellet weapons like shotguns; one shot still consumes exactly one ammo. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs resources weapons-kit|Docs: resources / weapons-kit]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/weapons-kit) Set GravityFactor to 1 for arcing projectiles like crossbow arrows; keep 0 for straight rockets. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs resources weapons-kit|Docs: resources / weapons-kit]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/weapons-kit) Tune damage falloff with FullDamageDistance (default 1000) and ZeroDamageDistance (default 10000). ([[2026-10-28 - Docs resources weapons-kit|Docs: resources / weapons-kit]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/weapons-kit) Set ExplodeOnImpact true with BlastRadius (default 8), BlastPressure (10000) and BlastDamage (100) for explosive projectiles. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs resources weapons-kit|Docs: resources / weapons-kit]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/education/battle-royale-series/cleanup-and-reset) Remove equipped and backpack copies of weapons at match end so tools do not carry over into the next round. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs education battle-royale-series cleanup-and-reset|Docs: education / battle-royale-series / cleanup-a]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/education/lesson-plans/roblox-developer/roblox-developer-3) Mark each collectible with a BoolValue named CanHarvest set to true, and keep every item in the same Explorer structure. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/effects/particle-emitters) Use PNG textures with transparent backgrounds; for grayscale textures without alpha, set LightEmission to 1 to hide dark regions. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs effects particle-emitters|Docs: effects / particle-emitters]])

- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/effects/particle-emitters) For rain, use a transparent anchored Part, EmissionDirection Bottom, positive Squash (e.g. 3) for streaks, and a grid of emitter parts for large areas. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/sound/dynamic-effects) Use EchoSoundEffect for repeating delayed sound with diminishing volume, suited to walls and caves. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs sound dynamic-effects|Docs: sound / dynamic-effects]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/audio/add-3D-audio) Set SoundService.DefaultListenerLocation to Character so an AudioListener is auto-created under each player's HumanoidRootPart. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials audio add-3D-audio|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / audio / add]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/audio/add-3D-audio) Create seamless loops by matching end and start points precisely; use Reaper or Audacity to find a zero crossing and cut carefully. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials audio add-3D-audio|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / audio / add]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/audio/add-3D-audio) Set AudioEmitter DistanceAttenuation to {0: 1}, {20: 0.8}, {40: 0.4}, {80: 0} for a gradual falloff every 20 studs. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials audio add-3D-audio|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / audio / add]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/audio/add-3D-audio) Use a LocalScript calling AudioPlayer:Play() for looping ambience that should start when players join and stop when they leave. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials audio add-3D-audio|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / audio / add]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/audio/add-3D-audio) Pair one-shot 3D audio with visual feedback for object interactions; this improves clarity and accessibility for players with visual impairments. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials audio add-3D-audio|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / audio / add]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/audio/add-3D-audio) Don't rely on IsPlaying going true-to-false for state changes; it only fires false-to-true due to replication timing, so also listen to AudioPlayer.Ended. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials audio add-3D-audio|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / audio / add]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/audio/add-3D-audio) Use a debounce (false to true to false after audio ends) on volume triggers to prevent repeated playback while players stay inside. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials audio add-3D-audio|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / audio / add]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/audio/add-3D-audio) Use non-positional Audio (2D) for background music, UI sounds and voiceover cutscene dialogue; positional audio is for in-world sources. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials audio add-3D-audio|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / audio / add]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/audio/add-3D-audio) Use 3D audio for situational events (e.g. door opening after objective completion) so players know where to go regardless of their position. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials audio add-3D-audio|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / audio / add]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/audio/add-text-to-speech) Use TTS for dynamic dialogue (UI, tutorials, vendor lines, enemy barks) instead of pre-recording audio for every narrative scenario. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials audio add-text-to-speech|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / audio / add]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/audio/add-text-to-speech) Set SoundService.DefaultListenerLocation to Character so each player gets an AudioListener under their HumanoidRootPart for positional 3D audio. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials audio add-text-to-speech|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / audio / add]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/audio/add-text-to-speech) Set AudioTextToSpeech Volume high (e.g. 3) when TTS must be heard over other audio sources. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials audio add-text-to-speech|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / audio / add]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/audio/add-text-to-speech) Tune AudioTextToSpeech VoiceID, Pitch and Speed to make the same text sound like different characters without new audio files. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials audio add-text-to-speech|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / audio / add]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/the-mystery-of-duvall-drive) Use SoundService with volumetric audio to craft distinct soundscapes per area or state, such as normal versus corrupted worlds. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs resources the-mystery-of-duvall-drive|Docs: resources / the-mystery-of-duvall-drive]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/art) Make seamless audio loops with the staff technique for ambience, music and sound effects. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs art|Docs: art]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/art) Add 3D audio or 2D audio depending on whether the sound should be spatial. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs art|Docs: art]])

## [[optimization-and-streaming]]
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/curriculums/environmental-art/optimize-your-experience) Combine groups of meshes into a single asset to reduce GPU draw calls (example: 8 draw calls reduced to 1), but only late in development since it locks per-part editing. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials curriculums environmental-art optimize-your-experience|Docs: tutorials / curriculums / environmental-art ]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/curriculums/environmental-art/optimize-your-experience) Avoid stacking many semi-transparent objects (foliage, glass) in layers across large screen areas; overlapping transparency causes costly overdraw. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials curriculums environmental-art optimize-your-experience|Docs: tutorials / curriculums / environmental-art ]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/curriculums/environmental-art/optimize-your-experience) Use the Microprofiler to find which frames and assets take the most render time, and Scene Analysis to check resource usage, before deciding what to cut. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials curriculums environmental-art optimize-your-experience|Docs: tutorials / curriculums / environmental-art ]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/curriculums/environmental-art/optimize-your-experience) Cull nonessential content that doesn't affect gameplay: duplicate textures, high-vertex geometry, and redundant transparent layers. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials curriculums environmental-art optimize-your-experience|Docs: tutorials / curriculums / environmental-art ]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/luau/native-code-gen) Measure each function with and without native compilation using the Script Profiler before keeping it enabled. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs luau native-code-gen|Docs: luau / native-code-gen]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/luau/native-code-gen) Run debug.dumpcodesize() in Server view to check native code size against the limit and find large compiled functions. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs luau native-code-gen|Docs: luau / native-code-gen]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/luau/native-code-gen) If a function exceeds instruction limits, split it into smaller functions or move large ones into a separate non-native script. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs luau native-code-gen|Docs: luau / native-code-gen]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/luau/native-code-gen) If memory allocation limit is hit, remove --!native from memory-heavy scripts or move rarely called functions to non-native modules. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs luau native-code-gen|Docs: luau / native-code-gen]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/performance) Set a rendering budget and measure your game against it, using the author's example figures as a starting reference rather than fixed targets. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs resources performance|Docs: resources / performance]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/performance) Cull distant or non-visible objects so they are not rendered, using visibility checks and distance culling. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs resources performance|Docs: resources / performance]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/education/adventure-game-series/collect-items) Use task.wait for respawn timing; the docs suggest 5 seconds as a starting value to tune per game. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs education adventure-game-series collect-items|Docs: education / adventure-game-series / collect-]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/workspace/streaming) Keep StreamingEnabled on (default for new places); it cuts memory use, join times and server bandwidth on lower-end devices. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs workspace streaming|Docs: workspace / streaming]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/workspace/streaming) Set ModelStreamingBehavior to Improved; it is the recommended, most efficient mode for models with BasePart descendants. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs workspace streaming|Docs: workspace / streaming]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/workspace/streaming) Set StreamOutBehavior to Opportunistic to aggressively garbage-collect content and reduce out-of-memory crashes. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs workspace streaming|Docs: workspace / streaming]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/workspace/streaming) Keep StreamingMinRadius at default 64 so the engine can scale down for low-end devices; larger values cost memory and bandwidth. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs workspace streaming|Docs: workspace / streaming]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/workspace/streaming) Keep StreamingTargetRadius at default 1024; smaller reduces server load but shortens the distance at which full detail is visible. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs workspace streaming|Docs: workspace / streaming]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/workspace/streaming) Keep StreamingTargetRadius larger than StreamingMinRadius; equal values remove the buffer and cause network pauses. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs workspace streaming|Docs: workspace / streaming]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/workspace/streaming) Set StreamingIntegrityMode to PauseOutsideLoadedArea to avoid gameplay issues when players enter unstreamed regions. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs workspace streaming|Docs: workspace / streaming]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/workspace/streaming) Enable PredictiveStreamingMode for fewer streaming pauses and pop-in with no code changes. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs workspace streaming|Docs: workspace / streaming]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/workspace/streaming) Use Atomic model streaming for models whose parts must arrive together; clients then need WaitForChild only on the model, not its parts. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs workspace streaming|Docs: workspace / streaming]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/workspace/streaming) Use Persistent models sparingly, only for a few parts client scripts must always access; overuse hurts performance. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs workspace streaming|Docs: workspace / streaming]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/workspace/streaming) Stream out client-created instances only if parented under server-created instances; client-created ones are exempt from streaming out. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs workspace streaming|Docs: workspace / streaming]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/workspace/streaming) Add replication foci (AddReplicationFocus) for home bases, hubs or distant viewpoints, but each extra focus adds server streaming load. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs workspace streaming|Docs: workspace / streaming]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/workspace/streaming) Keep assemblies small when moving; many instances streaming in together can cause network and CPU spikes. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs workspace streaming|Docs: workspace / streaming]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/workspace/streaming) Do not rely on instances in ReplicatedStorage for atomic replication; only Workspace descendants are streamed. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs workspace streaming|Docs: workspace / streaming]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/workspace/streaming) Use the Network Stats overlay (Shift+F3, then Shift+1 to the fourth panel) and colored radius regions to debug streaming. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs workspace streaming|Docs: workspace / streaming]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/scheduler) Do not rely on task.delay timing precision; measure actual elapsed time by passing os.clock() as an argument (e.g. about 2.04s for a 2s delay). ([[2026-10-28 - Docs scripting scheduler|Docs: scripting / scheduler]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/parts/solid-modeling) Fragmenting creates massive numbers of small pieces. Always add a cleanup system, such as Debris service removal after a set time, when letting users fragment objects. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs parts solid-modeling|Docs: parts / solid-modeling]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/parts/solid-modeling) Results over 20,000 triangles are simplified to 20,000; operations with thousands of non-overlapping components can error. Keep boolean inputs modest. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs parts solid-modeling|Docs: parts / solid-modeling]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/scene-analysis) Use Scene Analysis during play/test sessions to inspect both client and server data models for resource usage. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization scene-analysis|Docs: performance-optimization / scene-analysis]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/scene-analysis) Check Instance Composition regularly; each instance has replication and memory cost, so catch unintended counts (e.g. 25,000 particle emitters). ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization scene-analysis|Docs: performance-optimization / scene-analysis]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/scene-analysis) Deleting all instances referring to an audio track lets its memory unload; do this for unused audio. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization scene-analysis|Docs: performance-optimization / scene-analysis]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/scene-analysis) Animation assets are a common production memory leak: scripts often keep animations alive after the parent model is destroyed. Destroy all references so they unload. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization scene-analysis|Docs: performance-optimization / scene-analysis]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/scene-analysis) Don't trust Triangle Composition numbers as player-device figures; scaling makes a dev PC vs mid-range phone differ dramatically. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization scene-analysis|Docs: performance-optimization / scene-analysis]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/the-mystery-of-duvall-drive/develop-a-moving-world) Skinned meshes are not instanced; each adds memory cost, so use them sparingly and check current rigging docs for updates. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs resources the-mystery-of-duvall-drive develop-a-moving-world|Docs: resources / the-mystery-of-duvall-drive / de]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/the-mystery-of-duvall-drive/develop-a-moving-world) Avoid forcing many large objects to stream in; it can negate streaming benefits. Use sparingly. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs resources the-mystery-of-duvall-drive develop-a-moving-world|Docs: resources / the-mystery-of-duvall-drive / de]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/modules/selfie-mode) Depth-of-field does not render on mobile and needs graphics quality 8 or higher on non-mobile; lower-quality players are prompted to raise it, so expect the action to be missing on phones. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs resources modules selfie-mode|Docs: resources / modules / selfie-mode]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/guides/alerts/metrics) Monitor server frame rate and server CPU time by category to locate which systems cause server lag. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud guides alerts metrics|Docs: cloud / guides / alerts / metrics]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/effects/particle-emitters) Large particles cost GPU fill-rate; overlapping transparent layers cost overdraw. Limit both for performance. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs effects particle-emitters|Docs: effects / particle-emitters]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/effects/particle-emitters) Flipbook textures cost memory; clients disable flipbooks when low on memory (common on older phones). Reuse textures and use smaller resolutions. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs effects particle-emitters|Docs: effects / particle-emitters]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/effects/particle-emitters) On rain with flickering distant particles, lower emitter height and Lifetime, decrease Rate, or cover a smaller area with fewer emitter parts. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs effects particle-emitters|Docs: effects / particle-emitters]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/battle-royale/installation-and-setup) Set Server Fill to Maximum in Experience Settings for all six places so battle royale servers fill fully instead of Roblox's default social balancing. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs resources battle-royale installation-and-setup|Docs: resources / battle-royale / installation-and]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/projects/data-model) Store large maps in ServerStorage and move them into Workspace only when needed to decrease client network traffic on initial join. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs projects data-model|Docs: projects / data-model]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/projects/data-model) Remember that clients render only what is inside Workspace; objects elsewhere are not rendered. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs projects data-model|Docs: projects / data-model]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/workspace/streaming/frustum) Frustum streaming adds instances and full-quality terrain to the client, raising memory and possibly CPU use. Enable it only for games needing long-range visibility. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs workspace streaming frustum|Docs: workspace / streaming / frustum]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/workspace/streaming/frustum) Automatic mode has a short activation delay; use manual Enabled mode during an equip animation so a scope is ready when the player looks through it. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs workspace streaming frustum|Docs: workspace / streaming / frustum]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/workspace/streaming/frustum) Frustum streaming needs draw distance greater than the normal streaming target radius; low-end devices may have it disabled automatically. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs workspace streaming frustum|Docs: workspace / streaming / frustum]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/workspace/streaming/frustum) Frustum has no occlusion culling; walls and terrain do not block candidate instances, so streamed volume can exceed what is visible. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs workspace streaming frustum|Docs: workspace / streaming / frustum]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/workspace/streaming/frustum) Fast camera rotation invalidates the frustum and causes churn at extreme range; expect instances to stream in and out during rapid turns. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs workspace streaming frustum|Docs: workspace / streaming / frustum]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/workspace/streaming/frustum) Opportunistic stream-out keeps out-of-view frustum instances for 1.5 seconds before GC; LowMemory keeps them until client memory runs low. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs workspace streaming frustum|Docs: workspace / streaming / frustum]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/workspace/streaming/frustum) Frustum streams to the lesser of client draw distance and an engine maximum range; the engine disables it for a client when draw distance drops to or below the streaming target radius. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs workspace streaming frustum|Docs: workspace / streaming / frustum]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/memory-stores/observability) Keep memory store data structures lean: clean up processed data and avoid long expiration times, since extra data fills the memory quota even with few keys. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services memory-stores observability|Docs: cloud-services / memory-stores / observabili]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/lighting/enhance-indoor-environments) Point lights cost more on low-end devices since they project in every direction; use only as many as needed and combine small nearby sources into one. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials lighting enhance-indoor-environments|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / lighting / ]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/luau/comments) Keep --!optimize at default values unless you have a specific reason; level 1 is default in Studio testing, level 2 in live games. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs luau comments|Docs: luau / comments]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/lighting/enhance-outdoor-environments) Enable PointLight shadows only where they significantly add to the scene, because extra shadows can hurt performance on low-end devices. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials lighting enhance-outdoor-environment|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / lighting / ]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/environment/lighting) Set PrioritizeLightingQuality to true if shadows and shaders drive the artistic feel; set false to prioritize view distance. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs environment lighting|Docs: environment / lighting]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/ui/video-frames) Keep videos at 5 minutes or less, 4096×2160 max resolution, under 3.75 GB; alpha channels are ignored, so use opaque footage. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs ui video-frames|Docs: ui / video-frames]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/ui/video-frames) Only two videos can play simultaneously; plan screens so no more than two VideoFrames are active at once. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs ui video-frames|Docs: ui / video-frames]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/network-ownership) Client-owned parts offload physics from the server; use network ownership to free server time for other tasks. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics network-ownership|Docs: physics / network-ownership]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/studio/developer-console) Use the Script Profiler to record CPU time per script and find the scripts consuming the most CPU before optimizing. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs studio developer-console|Docs: studio / developer-console]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/studio/developer-console) Use the Luau heap snapshot comparison to find memory growth over time by taking multiple snapshots and diffing them. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs studio developer-console|Docs: studio / developer-console]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/mover-constraints) Use the Mechanisms visualization option to see groups of parts sharing simulation step and network ownership when debugging physics. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics mover-constraints|Docs: physics / mover-constraints]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/workspace/streaming/slim) Set Model.LevelOfDetail to SLIM on static world models (buildings, props, vehicles, terrain features); avoid runtime part add/remove or property changes on them. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs workspace streaming slim|Docs: workspace / streaming / slim]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/workspace/streaming/slim) Wait 1–2 minutes after first publish for cloud transcoding, then rejoin; transcoded assets persist on CDN. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs workspace streaming slim|Docs: workspace / streaming / slim]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics) Engine automatically sleeps assemblies that are not moving or accelerating; keep idle physics objects still to benefit from lower simulation cost. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics|Docs: physics]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/parts/textures-decals) Favor unique individual textures over texture atlases unless the atlas is on batchable parts; a high-res request for one atlas tile streams the whole atlas at that resolution. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs parts textures-decals|Docs: parts / textures-decals]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/parts/textures-decals) Keep near-uniform texel density in UV-mapped meshes so the engine can pick the best resolution per texture. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs parts textures-decals|Docs: parts / textures-decals]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/parts/textures-decals) Texture streaming is automatic; still manage texture memory for instance types it does not yet support. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs parts textures-decals|Docs: parts / textures-decals]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/extended-services) Diagnose Compute need first: check server heartbeat for persistent drops below 60 FPS and CPU core utilization on the Performance dashboard. - 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/curriculums/environmental-art/assemble-an-asset-library) Disable CanCollide on objects users never touch (e.g. foliage) to reduce physics calculation cost.
