- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/curriculums/environmental-art/assemble-an-asset-library) Enable CanTouch only on parts that must fire Touched/TouchEnded; the engine checks touch state every frame for every part. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials curriculums environmental-art assemble-an-asset-library|Docs: tutorials / curriculums / environmental-art ]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/curriculums/environmental-art/assemble-an-asset-library) Disable CanQuery on parts raycasts don't need to consider; keep it on surfaces that gameplay like lasers must hit. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials curriculums environmental-art assemble-an-asset-library|Docs: tutorials / curriculums / environmental-art ]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/curriculums/environmental-art/assemble-an-asset-library) Disable CastShadow on geometrically complex objects where users won't notice missing shadows, such as ceiling-piercing foliage. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials curriculums environmental-art assemble-an-asset-library|Docs: tutorials / curriculums / environmental-art ]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/curriculums/environmental-art/assemble-an-asset-library) Enable DoubleSided only where visual realism matters (e.g. foliage) since it renders polygons twice. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials curriculums environmental-art assemble-an-asset-library|Docs: tutorials / curriculums / environmental-art ]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/curriculums/environmental-art/assemble-an-asset-library) Set CollisionFidelity to Box or Hull for meshes where precise hitboxes are unnecessary; Hull for trim so users can still jump near walls. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials curriculums environmental-art assemble-an-asset-library|Docs: tutorials / curriculums / environmental-art ]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/curriculums/environmental-art/assemble-an-asset-library) Set RenderFidelity to Performance for complex geometry like foliage that need not display fully at distance. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials curriculums environmental-art assemble-an-asset-library|Docs: tutorials / curriculums / environmental-art ]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/microprofiler/task-scheduler) Don't bind functions to the render step unless necessary; reserve it for work that must run after input but before rendering, like camera movement. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization microprofiler task-scheduler|Docs: performance-optimization / microprofiler / t]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/microprofiler/task-scheduler) Avoid overloading the task scheduler: custom character rigs or input schemes, manually animating parts instead of using Animator, heavy precise physics, and frequent replication all add load. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization microprofiler task-scheduler|Docs: performance-optimization / microprofiler / t]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/art/overview-studio) Avoid loading many unique PBR textures at once; reuse a single PBR texture set and vary alpha channels with mesh base colors for similar meshes. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs art overview-studio|Docs: art / overview-studio]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/http-service) Stay under 2500 Open Cloud requests per minute per game server; exceeding it stalls request methods for about 30 seconds. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services http-service|Docs: cloud-services / http-service]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/http-service) Batch data into one request where the API offers a bulk endpoint, instead of one request per player; use RequestAsync to put data in the body. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services http-service|Docs: cloud-services / http-service]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/http-service) Send header names in lowercase, since HTTP/2 requires it; HttpService uses HTTP/2 automatically when available. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services http-service|Docs: cloud-services / http-service]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/projects/server-authority/techniques) Use Animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks to iterate all active tracks when stopping or filtering animations. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs projects server-authority techniques|Docs: projects / server-authority / techniques]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/data-storage/create-leaderboard) Poll the leaderboard on a fixed interval (the tutorial uses 3 seconds) rather than on every frame to limit server requests. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials data-storage create-leaderboard|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / data-storag]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/studio/network-simulator) Use MicroProfiler network capture to tell whether a delay is replication, physics or other network data, and separate it from frame-time problems. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs studio network-simulator|Docs: studio / network-simulator]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/test-on-hardware) Use MicroProfiler (Ctrl+Alt+F6 / Cmd+Opt+F6) and Developer Console (F9, Memory tab) on device to get real frame times and memory readings. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization test-on-hardware|Docs: performance-optimization / test-on-hardware]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/test-on-hardware) Enable Performance Stats in settings to view FPS, memory and ping overlay during on-device tests. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization test-on-hardware|Docs: performance-optimization / test-on-hardware]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/test-on-hardware) Run a 10–15 minute mobile session and watch for steady FPS decline, which indicates thermal throttling; then cut sustained GPU/CPU load in hot paths. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization test-on-hardware|Docs: performance-optimization / test-on-hardware]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/test-on-hardware) Confirm network behaviour over cellular or constrained Wi-Fi; simulation in Studio is only for quick iteration. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization test-on-hardware|Docs: performance-optimization / test-on-hardware]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/test-on-hardware) Time the full join-to-gameplay flow on the baseline device; if loads exceed a few seconds, consider instance streaming and check for pop-in during movement. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization test-on-hardware|Docs: performance-optimization / test-on-hardware]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/memory-stores) Cache values on the server and recheck after an interval (e.g. 30 s) to reduce request volume. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services memory-stores|Docs: cloud-services / memory-stores]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/memory-stores) Shard sorted maps/queues by prefix or user ID digits, and shard hot hash map keys with multiple copies, to spread load across partitions. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services memory-stores|Docs: cloud-services / memory-stores]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/memory-stores) Batch requests where possible and apply exponential backoff on throttling or DataUpdateConflict responses. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services memory-stores|Docs: cloud-services / memory-stores]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/memory-stores) Remove processed items explicitly with RemoveAsync; treat expiration as a safety net, not the primary cleanup. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services memory-stores|Docs: cloud-services / memory-stores]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/memory-stores) Set expiration to the shortest practical time when adding data; the default is 45 days, which can exhaust memory quota. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services memory-stores|Docs: cloud-services / memory-stores]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/memory-stores) Store only necessary values, e.g. keep just the highest bid in one key instead of all bids. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services memory-stores|Docs: cloud-services / memory-stores]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/memory-stores) Compress stored values (e.g. LZW) and keep values under the 32 KB item size limit by splitting across keys. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services memory-stores|Docs: cloud-services / memory-stores]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/memory-stores) Monitor the Observability dashboard (Memory Usage chart, Request Count by Status) and confirm Success responses outnumber NoItemFound responses. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services memory-stores|Docs: cloud-services / memory-stores]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/mechanical-constraints) Enable Mechanisms visualization in the 3D viewport to see groups of parts sharing simulation step and network ownership. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics mechanical-constraints|Docs: physics / mechanical-constraints]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/design) Choose one baseline low-end device and test on it throughout development; watch frame rate and memory, not just Studio results. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization design|Docs: performance-optimization / design]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/design) Keep draw calls under about 1,000 and triangles under about 1,000,000 on your baseline device, per the docs' example thresholds. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization design|Docs: performance-optimization / design]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/design) Don't rely on the Studio device emulator for memory; Studio runs server and client together, so memory use is significantly higher than on a real device. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization design|Docs: performance-optimization / design]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/design) Enable instance streaming for most places, especially large ones; it improves join times, reduces memory, and raises frame rate. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization design|Docs: performance-optimization / design]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/design) Splitting a large place into multiple places reduces initial join time but adds join time on each teleport; weigh this against streaming. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization design|Docs: performance-optimization / design]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/ui/list-flex-layouts) Only apply flex when needed; it adds a slight performance cost over non-flex, especially on resize or when dynamically adding/removing flex items. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs ui list-flex-layouts|Docs: ui / list-flex-layouts]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/modules/friends-locator) If clicking a locator causes streaming pauses under StreamingEnabled, call RequestStreamAroundAsync at the target position in the clicked handler. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs resources modules friends-locator|Docs: resources / modules / friends-locator]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/the-mystery-of-duvall-drive/construct-the-house) Mobile experiences are limited to 10,000 vertices per mesh; avoid scan UVs made of many separate planes. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs resources the-mystery-of-duvall-drive construct-the-house|Docs: resources / the-mystery-of-duvall-drive / co]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/the-mystery-of-duvall-drive/foundational-gameplay-systems) Hide teleports behind a cutscene and call RequestStreamAroundAsync before moving players; add a timeout so the flow proceeds if streaming never reports done. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs resources the-mystery-of-duvall-drive foundational-gameplay-syste|Docs: resources / the-mystery-of-duvall-drive / fo]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/monitor) Watch client memory on lower-end devices; steadily growing usage can cause crashes there even when Studio looks fine. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization monitor|Docs: performance-optimization / monitor]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/monitor) Check the Developer Console Memory tab, PlaceScriptMemory breakdown, to find scripts whose memory grows with player interactions. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization monitor|Docs: performance-optimization / monitor]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/data-stores/error-codes-and-limits) Limit writes per key: per-key throughput caps at 4 MB per minute for writes and 25 MB per minute for reads, rounded up per request to the next KB. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services data-stores error-codes-and-limits|Docs: cloud-services / data-stores / error-codes-a]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/data-stores/error-codes-and-limits) For Open Cloud loops, add a delay of 60 / (desired requests per minute) seconds, or use a leaky bucket limiter for bursts. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services data-stores error-codes-and-limits|Docs: cloud-services / data-stores / error-codes-a]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/parts/procedural-models) Call parameters:Pause() liberally at the start of loops in generators; it is inexpensive and prevents Script Timeout errors by deferring work to later frames. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs parts procedural-models|Docs: parts / procedural-models]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/parts/models) With streaming enabled, set key models to Persistent so they never stream out, or Atomic to stream as one unit with descendants. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs parts models|Docs: parts / models]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/parts/models) Set models to SLIM or imposter mesh levels of detail when streamed out to avoid jarring pop-in. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs parts models|Docs: parts / models]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/studio/avatar-settings) Leave Abilities on Legacy Humanoid unless you need Character Controller Library; the library can be toggled on or off at runtime. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs studio avatar-settings|Docs: studio / avatar-settings]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/adaptive-timestepping) Use Microprofiler (Ctrl+F6) and pause (Ctrl+P) to check worldStep - Adaptive and LDLPGSSolver::solve island counts per frequency bucket. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics adaptive-timestepping|Docs: physics / adaptive-timestepping]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/adaptive-timestepping) Use Fixed mode (240 Hz) for racing, destruction, or tank-style mechanism games needing high accuracy and stability. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics adaptive-timestepping|Docs: physics / adaptive-timestepping]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/adaptive-timestepping) Avoid Adaptive if most parts default to 240 Hz; mixing with 60-120 Hz islands converts them to 240 Hz and can negate gains. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs physics adaptive-timestepping|Docs: physics / adaptive-timestepping]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/tutorials/use-case-tutorials/vfx/create-volcanoes) Flipbooks cost memory; clients disable them when memory is low, which is likely on older mobile phones. Use fewer animated effects or smaller textures. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs tutorials use-case-tutorials vfx create-volcanoes|Docs: tutorials / use-case-tutorials / vfx / creat]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/avatar/in-experience-creation-makeup) Check AssetService:CreateEditableImage() return value; nil means not enough editable memory, so handle it gracefully. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs avatar in-experience-creation-makeup|Docs: avatar / in-experience-creation-makeup]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/workspace/raycasting) Raycasts may miss distant BaseParts when instance streaming is enabled, since clients may not have them loaded; streamed imposter terrain/models are not targets. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs workspace raycasting|Docs: workspace / raycasting]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/environment/skybox) SkyboxOrientation is a low-cost feature that works across all platforms and quality levels, so animating it is cheap. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs environment skybox|Docs: environment / skybox]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/the-mystery-of-duvall-drive/main-design-requirements) Store alternate room states far off-map (about 6,500 studs away) and clone them in on demand from ServerStorage, so the house stays lightweight. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs resources the-mystery-of-duvall-drive main-design-requirements|Docs: resources / the-mystery-of-duvall-drive / ma]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/ui/viewport-frames) For rotation, drive the viewport camera in RunService.PostSimulation using delta time rather than a fixed wait loop. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs ui viewport-frames|Docs: ui / viewport-frames]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/resources/the-mystery-of-duvall-drive) Enable Streaming Enabled for large, complex games and structure the world and code to work with streaming. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs resources the-mystery-of-duvall-drive|Docs: resources / the-mystery-of-duvall-drive]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/data-stores/best-practices) Stagger recurring requests: assign a random initial offset before fixed-frequency loops and add bounded random jitter to polling intervals. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud-services data-stores best-practices|Docs: cloud-services / data-stores / best-practice]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/microprofiler) Aim for consistent frame times, not just high FPS; one 410 ms frame among 59 frames in 10 ms causes a jarring stutter even at 60 FPS. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization microprofiler|Docs: performance-optimization / microprofiler]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/microprofiler) Don't rely on desktop profiling with a 60 FPS cap; a 4 ms vs 16 ms frame looks identical, but on mobile a 133 ms frame is easy to notice. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization microprofiler|Docs: performance-optimization / microprofiler]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/microprofiler) Use orange bars (Jobs Wall Time > Render Wall Time) to investigate scripts, physics and animations when frame goals are missed. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization microprofiler|Docs: performance-optimization / microprofiler]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/microprofiler) Use blue bars (Render Wall Time > Jobs Wall Time) to diagnose rendering bottlenecks: object density, object movement and lighting. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization microprofiler|Docs: performance-optimization / microprofiler]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/microprofiler) Red bars (render-bound with GPU Wait Time > 2.5 ms) usually come from object complexity, texture size and visual effects. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization microprofiler|Docs: performance-optimization / microprofiler]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/microprofiler) Focus on frame time rather than bar colour; colour mixes are fine if frame time goals are met, and colour only guides optimisation when goals are missed. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization microprofiler|Docs: performance-optimization / microprofiler]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/microprofiler) When drilling into a parent task, troubleshoot its worst-performing child tasks; a parent can never be shorter than the sum of its children. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization microprofiler|Docs: performance-optimization / microprofiler]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/microprofiler) Use flame graphs (Export menu in web UI) to find frequently-run tasks that are individually cheap but add up to significant time. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization microprofiler|Docs: performance-optimization / microprofiler]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/microprofiler) Dumps only contain the selected frames, not the full session; use counters mode if you need data from startup to the dump time. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization microprofiler|Docs: performance-optimization / microprofiler]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/assistant/skills) Use rbx-scene-analysis (SceneAnalysisService) to hunt unparented-instance leaks and find what dominates memory in large places. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs assistant skills|Docs: assistant / skills]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/microprofiler/tag-table) Reduce pathfinding tile invalidations; they force paths to be recomputed. Invalidations are caused by non-navigable parts moving. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization microprofiler tag-table|Docs: performance-optimization / microprofiler / t]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/microprofiler/tag-table) Reduce minimum and target streaming radii to lower StreamJob dispatch cost. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization microprofiler tag-table|Docs: performance-optimization / microprofiler / t]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/microprofiler/tag-table) Lower FallenPartsDestroyHeight, or reduce parts falling to it, to cut handleFallenParts cost. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization microprofiler tag-table|Docs: performance-optimization / microprofiler / t]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/microprofiler/tag-table) Use CanvasGroups to reduce UI rendering cost at the expense of more memory. Reduce UIGradient and UICorner on text labels. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization microprofiler tag-table|Docs: performance-optimization / microprofiler / t]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/microprofiler/tag-table) Reduce the number of lights and shadow-casting geometry; use non-shadow-casting geometry for moving objects. Shadows are not computed below quality level 4. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization microprofiler tag-table|Docs: performance-optimization / microprofiler / t]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/microprofiler/tag-table) If waitUntilCompleted is high, too much is rendered; reduce scene complexity and use the Frame Rate Manager. If Present is high, you may be GPU-limited. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization microprofiler tag-table|Docs: performance-optimization / microprofiler / t]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization/microprofiler/tag-table) Reduce the number of BillboardGuis and Humanoid name/health labels that are visible to lower Pass3dAdorn cost. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs performance-optimization microprofiler tag-table|Docs: performance-optimization / microprofiler / t]])

## [[version-control-and-tooling]]
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/projects/collaboration) Enable Drafts Mode (File > Experience Settings) to edit scripts locally and commit to a shared repository, similar to source control; it is disabled by default. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs projects collaboration|Docs: projects / collaboration]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/projects/collaboration) In Drafts, use Compare With Server and Merge From Server to resolve conflicts before committing collaborator changes. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs projects collaboration|Docs: projects / collaboration]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud) Avoid legacy Open Cloud APIs for production: they use cookie auth, may change without notice, and have minimal stability guarantees. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs cloud|Docs: cloud]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/art/modeling/roblox-blender-plugin) The plugin is open-source and built on Open Cloud API; fork or extend it for your own pipeline tooling. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs art modeling roblox-blender-plugin|Docs: art / modeling / roblox-blender-plugin]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/studio/plugins) Enable Plugin Debugging Enabled in Studio settings to get PluginDebugService for live debugging and reloading plugin code. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs studio plugins|Docs: studio / plugins]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/studio/plugins) Delete the original script after 'Save as Local Plugin' and edit only the copy in PluginDebugService to avoid applying changes to the wrong script. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs studio plugins|Docs: studio / plugins]])
- 2026-10-28 [page](https://create.roblox.com/docs/studio/plugins) Store the last recording identifier in attributes so an unfinished recording can be cancelled when the plugin reloads. ([[2026-10-28 - Docs studio plugins|Docs: studio / plugins]])
